results.timing: synchronized calls; durable journal/checkpoint overhead excluded from per-call latency

independent_audit.method: Independent NumPy/SciPy arithmetic and archive/journal fingerprints, all paired outcomes and tail metrics, v7 envelope/v6 historical RMS endpoint Hessian penalties,23 pre-assimilation archives and measured-cache identities. No Glassbox/JAX imports.
independent_audit.limit: Authenticates saved causal ordering and arithmetic; does not rerun optimizer or regenerate predictions. Known tapes are not blind generalization.

independent_causal_audit.method: Independent NumPy physical features, hidden/filter history, six heads and closed-form local Jacobians; SciPy SO3 exponential; saved midpoint integration and angular accounting. No Glassbox/JAX imports. No optimizer or trajectory replay.
independent_causal_audit.scope: Known selected pre-assimilation snapshots; validates diagnostic arithmetic, not generalization or causal effect of head removal. The official source verifier owns causal snapshot/tape pairing; this audit does not repeat optimizer transitions.

independent_common_domain_audit.method: Byte-identical retained bootstrap/recent/tail observations and commands, immutable raw normalizers and fixed loss scales; same v7 motion/command envelope; full symmetric physical Hessian assembled separately from each saved coefficient/output/quadratic scale set, then squared Frobenius prior evaluated with NumPy.
independent_common_domain_audit.limit: Posthoc comparison of different online fitting trajectories on identical retained data. Verifies a shared measurement, not objective convergence, causal effect of a particular update, head ablation, fresh-data performance, or an additional adoption gate.
